verdict.rationale: The first-party Grok Build docs in the pack never describe a training opt-out or data-usage control. The only mention of one is a community report of an 'Improve the model' toggle, and that report says the toggle makes no difference to what gets uploaded. With only one tier of evidence, a 'disputed' verdict is not supported, and an undocumented, unverified community mention does not earn partial credit for an opt-out the product itself provides.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
